items.information: ## Oakville Fall 2022 Series This is a competition in a series with [Oakville Fall A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallA2022). You will only be able to register for *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminder You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.information: ## Português * O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato. * A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir. ***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 120 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.*** -------------------- ## English * The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab. * The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Without that, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to compete at the day of the competition. ***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 120 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by the date of payment.***
